title: 第一章 武道盛世征兵诏令第二章  每日结算箭术入门
slug: 武道长生从边关猎户开始黄袍加身
lines: 大靖王朝。
潼谷关，河西县城。
陆川昏昏沉沉，依稀听到耳边传来一道温柔的女声呼喊着。
“川哥儿，川哥儿......”
“你若死了，我一人在这世上怎么活？倒不如随你去了。”
女声轻轻叫着，转而变得幽怨，似在喃喃自语。
陆川只觉得头痛欲裂，缓缓睁开眼来。
映入眼帘的是两座高耸的山峰儿，他微微抬头，正对着一张清秀的脸庞，梨花带雨，似娇似怨。
“川哥儿？你醒了？”
女人见陆川睁开眼，顿时惊喜叫出声来。
陆川愣神片刻，干哑地说出一句话。
“好！好！川哥儿，你等会，我去拿水来。”
见女人远去，陆川才回过神来，下意识打量着周围。
他身处的地方是一间土屋，空空荡荡，除了身下床铺外，只有前方不远处黑漆漆的灶台。
这是哪？
陆川又感到一阵剧烈的头痛，依稀间，一座高耸入云的石碑光芒乍现，无数信息凭空涌现在他的记忆中。
等陆川将脑海中涌现的信息全部吸收完毕，他搞清了如今的情况。
陆川露出不可置信的神色，抬手摸了摸脸庞。
他下意识从床铺上撑起身子，正要下地，却见先前的女人捧着一碗清水，往他这边走来。
陆川连忙将神情收敛，目光看向走来的女人。
他在记忆中得知，女人的名字叫叶莞君，算是原身的童养媳。
据说是发配到边疆的罪人后代，身份是官府名录里最下等的贱籍。
原身自视甚高，妄想通过文试走上仕途，平日里不事生产，对叶莞君也多是看不起，但自父亲去世，却是全由她一人干着多份活计，以此维持一家子的生活。
只见叶莞君侧坐在床铺上，轻轻扶起陆川，让他半躺在双膝上，随后将碗凑近他的嘴里，
“川哥儿，慢点喝。”
陆川见状，只得先按捺住探究的心思，顺势将碗里的清水一口喝完，这才缓解了干渴的喉咙。
他沉吟片刻，正要开口说话，叶莞君率先开口温柔的劝解道：
“川哥儿，这潼谷关征兵，纵然你不想去，咱也能另想法子，你又何必要自寻短见。”
“我们找街坊邻里，借些银钱，再加上余下的积蓄，说不定也能凑齐十两银子，用来交那免役税。”
潼谷关？免役税？
陆川抓住了叶莞君话里的重点，搜寻一番记忆，这才知道原身死亡的原因。
他身处的地方乃是大靖王朝的边陲县城，河西县。
再往西二百里地，便是另一个王朝，大蛮王朝的国土。
大靖与大蛮的交界之地，设有一座雄关，名为潼谷关，关中派有重兵把守，以防止大蛮国的侵略。
在以往的时候，两国之间虽有摩擦，但也只限于小打小闹，双方均有克制，因此在近十年来，两国之间都没有发生过大型的战争。
但在半年前，大蛮新帝登基，雄心勃勃，再加上经过多年休养生息，国内强兵强将数不胜数，为了做出一番功业，毅然挥兵东出，一举侵略大靖国土。
在这种情况下，潼谷关自然成了双方争夺的要地。
三天前，潼谷关与蛮人又一次发生大战，双方死伤惨重。
为了补充兵源，都司府在各镇颁布征兵诏令，每户必须有一名成年男性应召入伍，驻守边关。
原身正是因为惧怕战场厮杀，惶惶不安，一念之差，便选择了自寻短见。
content_en:
Dajing Dynasty.
Tonggu Pass, Hexi County.
Lu Chuan was drowsy and vaguely heard a gentle female voice calling in his ears.
"Brother Chuan, Brother Chuan..."
"If you die, how can I live alone in this world? It's better to let you go."
The female voice screamed softly, then turned resentful, seeming to be mumbling to herself.
Lu Chuan felt a splitting headache and slowly opened his eyes.
What came into view were two towering mountain peaks. He raised his head slightly and faced a delicate face with pear blossoms and rain, which seemed delicate and resentful.
"Brother Chuan? Are you awake?"
When the woman saw Lu Chuan open his eyes, she screamed in surprise.
"Water..."
Lu Chuan was stunned for a moment and said something hoarsely.
"Okay! Okay! Brother Chuan, wait a moment, I'll get some water."
Seeing the woman walking away, Lu Chuan came back to his senses and subconsciously looked around.
The place he was in was a mud house, empty, except for the bed under him, there was only a dark stove not far in front.
Where is this?
Lu Chuan felt another severe headache. Suddenly, the light of a towering stone monument suddenly appeared, and countless information appeared in his memory out of thin air.
After Lu Chuan absorbed all the information that came to his mind, he understood the current situation.
"I... traveled through time?"
Lu Chuan looked in disbelief and raised his hand to touch his face.
He subconsciously pushed himself up from the bed and was about to get off the ground when he saw the woman from before walking towards him holding a bowl of water.
Lu Chuan quickly calmed down his expression and looked at the approaching woman.
He learned in his memory that the woman's name was Ye Wanjun, and she was considered a child bride.
It is said that he is the descendant of criminals who were sent to the frontier, and his status is the lowest in the official list.
She had a high self-esteem and wanted to enter the official career through the literary examination. She did not work on production on weekdays and looked down on Ye Wanjun. However, since her father passed away, she has been doing multiple jobs by herself to maintain the life of the family.
I saw Ye Guanjun sitting sideways on the bed, gently helping Lu Chuan, letting him lie half on his knees, and then put the bowl close to his mouth,
"Brother Chuan, drink slowly."
Seeing this, Lu Chuan had no choice but to suppress his inquiring thoughts and drank the water in the bowl in one gulp, which relieved his thirsty throat.
He pondered for a moment and was about to speak when Ye Guanjun took the lead and gently persuaded:
"Brother Chuan, even if you don't want to go to the Tonggu Pass recruitment, we can find another way, so why do you have to commit suicide?"
"Let's borrow some money from the neighbors, and with the remaining savings, maybe we can get together ten taels of silver to pay the tax exemption."
Tonggu Pass? Tax exemption?
Lu Chuan grasped the key point of Ye Wanjun's words, searched his memory, and then found out the reason for his death.
The place he was in was Hexi County, a border county of the Dajing Dynasty.
Two hundred miles further to the west is the land of another dynasty, the Barbarian Dynasty.
At the junction of Dajing and Daman, there was a magnificent pass called Tonggu Pass. The pass was heavily guarded by troops to prevent the invasion of Daman.
In the past, although there were frictions between the two countries, they were limited to minor fights. Both sides exercised restraint. Therefore, in the past ten years, there has been no major war between the two countries.
But half a year ago, the new emperor of Daman came to the throne. He was very ambitious. In addition, after years of recuperation, he had countless strong soldiers and generals in the country. In order to make some achievements, he resolutely sent his troops eastward and invaded the land of Dajing in one fell swoop.
In this case, Tonggu Pass naturally became an important place for both sides to compete.
Three days ago, another battle broke out between Tonggu Pass and the barbarians, resulting in heavy casualties on both sides.
In order to replenish the supply of troops, the Dusi Prefecture issued a conscription edict in each town. Each household must have an adult male enlisted in the army and stationed at the border.
It was precisely because he was afraid of fighting on the battlefield that he was so panic-stricken that he decided to commit suicide.
